_comment: Every image here is pinned by digest, which Dependabot cannot bump for
Kubernetes manifests -- it only reads Dockerfiles and docker-compose.
Renovate is what moves those pins.
Requires the Renovate GitHub App to be installed on this repository.

packageRules.description: The media stack moves together and breaks together; one PR for all of it keeps the *arr apps in step.
The assistant is the one stack whose breakage is noticed immediately, so its images get individual PRs that can be reverted individually.
open-webui tracks a development branch, so a bump is a real change rather than a patch. Never group it, and never automerge it.
cloudflared and busybox are infrastructure: a stale tunnel client eventually stops connecting, so let these through on their own.
